name: shanewas-plugins
description: Universal multi-agent plugin & skill marketplace by Shanewas Ahmed — supporting Claude Code, Antigravity, OpenCode, Hermes, and Muse.

plugins.name: core-tools
plugins.description: Universal core developer tools, audit agent, and repository summary skills.

plugins.name: slop-gate
plugins.description: Zero-dependency AI-slop scorer and edit gate: warn or block on sloppy prose.

plugins.name: audit-trail
plugins.description: Zero-dependency edit ledger and review digest: log hook events to JSONL, render per-file digests.

plugins.name: minimal-diff
plugins.description: Zero-dependency diff-size gate: warn or block when a change is too big for one review.

plugins.name: verify-done
plugins.description: Zero-dependency done-claim gate: warn or block when a done claim lacks build, test, or artifact evidence.

plugins.name: review-pair
plugins.description: Zero-dependency review-findings shape gate: warn or block when review lines are not machine-readable.

plugins.name: commit-gate
plugins.description: Zero-dependency commit-message and staged-file gate: warn or block on bad shape, AI trailers, and banned extensions.
